name: Zhang Yuanxin
source:
“Mankind is doomed to repeat such sorrows, until the chosen one rises to stay the hand of fate.”

The boy who sits directly in front of Cheng Feng. His grades leave a lot to be desired, but his enthusiasm for mysteries and deduction burns like an undying flame.
